claims.claim: Infleqtion announced on 2026-09-24 that it achieved 30 entangled logical qubits using 80 physical qubits on Sqale, directly closing the prior Beta unknown over whether the targeted 30-logical-qubit 2026 technical milestone had been reached, but not closing the separate question of customer economics or broad quantum advantage.

The new milestone reduces technical-roadmap uncertainty but does not remove commercialization, concentration, financing, manufacturing-scale or substitution risks documented in the company's filings; those remain distinct from milestone attainment.

risks.risk: Milestone attainment does not by itself establish economic quantum advantage, scalable customer workloads, manufacturing scale, or durable profitability.

contradictions.contradiction: The prior Beta unknown that independent verification of the targeted 30 logical qubits remained open is stale as a milestone-status statement after the SEC-filed September 24 announcement; customer-economics uncertainty remains open.
contradictions.disposition: append-only clarification; do not treat the technical milestone as proof of commercial utility

unknowns.unknown: Independent performance replication, workload-level economic advantage, customer economics and repeatable commercial utilization of the 30-logical-qubit system remain unverified in this assist.

lineage.note: Bounded assist evidence; does not replace the existing Beta structural-causal or adversarial-red-team perspectives.
